entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2095)
release_notes: You can send app logs to Auldera when you export them. The export tells you whether they were sent and keeps a copy on your Mac.
Settings › Advanced is simpler: detailed logging, crash reports, and Export Logs sit together, your account tools are on one card, and developer-only Zoom tools stay out of the way.
When a meeting synced from your other Mac goes into an Enhanced summary or question, that Mac now records it too, so each Mac's privacy record stays complete.
If your sign-in on this Mac stops working for good, Auldera now signs you out cleanly so you can sign in again. You no longer need to reset sign-in.
You can record with microphones and webcams that use a lower audio rate, including the Logitech C925e.
In two-person Zoom meetings, Auldera names the other person more often, including when Zoom shows no participant count or a single read briefly fails.
Auldera can name Zoom speakers in group meetings from the order of the gallery tiles, and it now reads meetings on free Zoom accounts.
Minimising the Zoom window, switching to speaker view, or pinning someone no longer stops your recording.
You can edit your meeting notes after recording, from any of your devices, and the summary tells you when it is behind your notes.

If a Mac could not sync Projects and Tags because their saved changes were damaged, Settings now offers Repair. Repair keeps your newest edits from other devices. A Mac that already has Projects or Tags waits for its first sync before you can change them.
Keep audio is now one simple menu, from Always to Until notes are written. New installs keep recordings for 30 days.
Naming Zoom speakers fills in your name, so it never turns on without one. The Accessibility reminder only appears when it's actually off.
Settings › AI now says where transcription and summaries run, and what each choice sends, in one sentence under each choice. A status appears only when something needs your attention.

Settings > Calendar is simpler. Your Apple and Google calendars are in one list grouped by account, and each account shows its status next to the one button it needs. If calendars can't be loaded, Try Again now works for Apple Calendar too. Meetings now always take their calendar event's name.
You can now create, rename, recolour, archive, and delete projects right in Settings > Projects & Tags. Archived projects sit in their own fold, and the word you use for projects sits at the top.

entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2066)
release_notes: The recording capsule, the menu bar window, About, and What's New now match Auldera's new look, with warm paper backgrounds and the new typefaces. The capsule stays easy to read over any app.
You can rename a meeting from any of your devices, and the new name appears on the others.

Auldera's Mac windows, capture capsule and menu bar now use the Folio look: warm paper backgrounds, a brick accent, and the Newsreader, Instrument Sans and IBM Plex Mono typefaces where text uses the new type roles.

entries.title: Auldera 0.1.0 (2063)
release_notes: Two Macs on one account now show the same project summary, and a Rewrite on one Mac replaces it on the other. A meeting recorded on another device shows the summary that device wrote.
Auldera has a new icon: seven bars with one tall red bar, in the Dock, in Finder, and in the menu bar. It also has a dark version for dark icon styles.
Speaker names, tag dots, and the meeting window's other colours now come from Auldera's own paper-and-ink palette, so every speaker reads clearly in light and dark.
You can now see Sync at work: the bottom of your meeting list and Sync settings show when your meetings last synced, a progress bar while they sync, and what to do if Sync stops.
Auldera now tells you when a recording starts if Zoom speaker names can't work because Accessibility is off, with a button to open System Settings and one to check again.
If Auldera already shows as allowed but names still don't work, it tells you how to fix it.
The Mac app no longer freezes for seconds when your list of synced meetings refreshes.
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
Settings is easier to find your way around: Account, Recording, Calendar, AI, Projects & Tags, App, and Advanced.
Every meeting now shows in your lists, however short. You no longer need an option to see recordings under a minute.
Changes you make on one Mac now show up on your other Mac by themselves, within about a minute, without you having to open anything.
Settings no longer asks you to finish activating private updates when your Mac already gets updates without it.
Auldera's meeting window and Settings have a lighter, cleaner look. Summaries and transcripts read in a clear book typeface, and buttons, tabs, and lists use a crisp modern one.
What's New now tells you what's new in Auldera in plain, simple words.
